environment.description: Same application deployed behind Cloudflare with the following configuration: (1) Page Rule on /explorer path enforces automatic SRI injection via Cloudflare's cdnjs SRI Auto-Rewrite feature (cf.sri_check=on), which intercepts HTML responses and appends integrity= attributes with sha384 hashes computed from the canonical CDN resource, causing any tampered or substituted script to fail browser integrity checks. (2) Cloudflare Transform Rule rewrites the debugCache resolver responses through a Workers script (bound to routes matching /graphql) that strips any JSON field matching the regex pattern /password|secret|credential/i from response bodies before they reach the client. (3) The Worker applies a response size cap of 8KB on any single GraphQL response field, preventing bulk cache exfiltration via the debugCache(key: null) path. Note: the SRI rewrite operates at the edge proxy layer on HTML content-type responses only, and the Worker-based field stripping operates on application/json responses from the GraphQL endpoint.

config.cdn_protection: Cloudflare SRI Auto-Rewrite (cf.sri_check=on) on text/html responses for /explorer
config.worker_logic: Response body JSON field stripping for keys matching /password|secret|credential|token.*raw/i
config.worker_response_cap: 8192 bytes per individual JSON string field in response
